_comment: Fast-lane e2e tests allowed past the PR-lane duration budget in scripts/e2e_durations.py. Every entry is a test a pull request waits for, so keep this list short and shrinking. Adding one needs a reason; the usual answer is @pytest.mark.slow instead.

allowed.why: provisions a real Docker sandbox (fast_workspace); the agent tool-calling contract has no in-process fake that proves it, so this is genuine work rather than a wait. Splitting a cheaper wiring half out of it is the way to remove it from this list.
